name: 1167-fault-in-body
about: a mod's before on MR::getRandom() faults while MR::getRandom(1.5, 4267.5)'s own code calls it: the guard resumes at that boundary inside the body, the body returns as usual, and the next call of the outer function runs its hooks (another mod's before counts 2)

expect.log: \[mod k1-fault\] GUARD: its code failed \(before hook: MR::getRandom\)
